question: How a Quote picks its rows from its content: rounding to the nearest row, or rounding up. Predicted before the read; CAP-T12QUOTE.json had one read (an empty Quote kept 3 rows at 3.265), which is seen and not scored.
how: A new Quote on the probe page at span 6, Edit, Content. Quote emptied with Cmd+A and Backspace. Then in Source, at its end, Enter and x five times, reading the rows after each; then Backspace twice five times. Then in Quote: A, then Enter and a letter three times, then Backspace twice three times. Rows read from the block's grid area; the content height (content box and padding) read as well, as rows = (height + 11) / 41.094.

contentRows.note: From ours, which has the same boxes (CAP-75QUOTE.json, CAP-T12QUOTE.json): x = (content height + gap 11) / pitch 41.094 at span 6.

rules.growUpShrinkNearest: when the content grows, the rows grow to ceil(x - 0.02) if that is more; when it shrinks, rows = round(x)
